user.title: Yunting Radio
user.description: Add a DLNA speaker to play from and watch, or just add the Yunting Radio media source if you already have a player?

device.title: Add speaker
device.description: Pick a DLNA renderer on your LAN, or type the device description URL if the list is empty.

source_only.title: Media source only
source_only.description: No device: just registers the Yunting Radio media source (941 stations, browsable and searchable). Pick your own player in the bottom-right of the media panel to play.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to this device, check the URL and network

abort.single_instance_allowed: The media source is already enabled

data.stream_prefix: Prefix live stream URLs with ffmpeg:// (required by GEAK speakers)

data_description.stream_prefix: When disabled the plain http URL is sent; GEAK speakers accept it but stay silent.
data_description.quality: Prefer high bitrate or low bitrate streams.
data_description.line: auto picks high quality first; m3u8/mp3 pins a specific line.

push_station.name: Push station
push_station.description: Push a 云听 station to the speaker by name (fuzzy) or contentId.

entity_id.name: Target players
entity_id.description: Defaults to every player added by this integration.

add_favorite.name: Add favorite
add_favorite.description: Add a station to favorites; leave the station empty to favorite whatever is playing.

station.name: Station
station.description: Station name or contentId; empty means the currently playing station.

remove_favorite.name: Remove favorite
remove_favorite.description: Remove a station from favorites; leave the station empty for the currently playing one.

station.name: Station
station.description: Station name or contentId; empty means the currently playing station.

reboot.name: Reboot speaker
reboot.description: Reboot every Yunting Radio device (no button confirmation; for automations).

shutdown.name: Shutdown speaker
shutdown.description: Shut down every Yunting Radio device (no button confirmation; for automations). The speaker loses power and must be turned on manually.

rediscover.name: Re-discover devices
rediscover.description: Re-discover every device address on the LAN via UDN and store it back (use after the device changed IP/port). Returns the found address per device, null when not found.
